page.title: Video editor
page.intro: Trim a video, add text, pictures, subtitles and sound. The original file stays as it is: the result is saved as a new file.
page.notFound: This project was not found. It may have been deleted.
page.name: Project name
page.deleteAsk: Delete this project? The video and the saved results stay in the media library.
page.leaveAsk: The last changes are not saved. Leave anyway?
page.sourceMissing: The original video is gone from the media library. You can look at the project, but cannot save a new video.

canvas.removedHere: This part is cut out and will not be in the result

time.nowHint: Take the current moment of the video

timeline.startHereHint: The result will start at the current moment
timeline.endHereHint: The result will end at the current moment
timeline.markInHint: Mark where a part to cut out begins
timeline.markOutHint: Mark where a part to cut out ends
timeline.removeHint: Cut out the part between the marks
timeline.splitHint: Mark a place where the video will be divided into separate files when you save it

layers.empty: Nothing added yet. Text and pictures appear on top of the video.
layers.limit: At most {layers} items, of them {pictures} pictures.
layers.orderHint: Items higher in the list are in front.
layers.selectHint: Click an item in the list or on the video to change it.
layers.dragHint: You can also drag it on the video.

brand.title: Brand kit
brand.hint: Fonts, colors and pictures of the brand kit become available in the editor.
brand.layersHint: Its fonts and pictures appear in the lists below.
brand.subtitlesHint: The “Brand” subtitle look takes its color and font from here.
brand.changed: The brand kit has changed since you picked it.

picker.empty: Nothing here yet. Upload a file from your computer.

subtitles.recognizeHint: The app listens to the video and writes the speech down. It works on this computer and is free.
subtitles.noSound: This video has no sound, so there is nothing to recognize.
subtitles.againAsk: Recognize the speech again? Your edits to the subtitle text will be lost.
subtitles.estimateGuess: It will take about {time}. This is a rough guess: the app has not measured your computer yet.
subtitles.estimateMeasured: It will take about {time} (measured on your last {n} run). | It will take about {time} (measured on your last {n} runs).
subtitles.modelFirst: The first time, the model will be downloaded: {size}.
subtitles.recognized: No speech found in the video | Speech recognized: {n} word | Speech recognized: {n} words
subtitles.reused: Took the text recognized earlier: {n} word | Took the text recognized earlier: {n} words
subtitles.brandMissing: Pick a brand kit, or the subtitles will use the usual colors.
subtitles.clearAsk: Delete all subtitle text? To get it back you will need to recognize the speech again.
subtitles.editHint: Fix mistakes right in the lines. Click the time to jump there.

clean.name: Clean
clean.text: White text with a dark outline, the spoken word is highlighted.

boxed.name: Boxed
boxed.text: Text on a dark box, easy to read over any picture.

pop.name: Pop
pop.text: One big word at a time in the middle of the frame.

brand.name: Brand
brand.text: Like Clean, but with the color and font of the brand kit.

stt.title: Speech models
stt.intro: Subtitles are made on this computer, for free. For this the app needs a speech model. It is downloaded once from the internet, after that it works without it.
stt.failed: The download failed. Check the internet and try again.
stt.deleteAsk: Delete this model? It frees {size}. You can download it again later.
stt.where: Models are kept in the app data folder on this computer.

modelHint.turbo: Makes fewer mistakes, but works slower and takes more disk space.
modelHint.small: Works faster and takes less space, but makes more mistakes.

phase.decoding: Taking the sound out of the video…

audio.keepOriginal: Keep the sound of the video
audio.louderHint: Above 100% the sound may crackle. Check it in the preview on the “Save” tab.
audio.tracksHint: Music, voice-over or sound effects from the media library or your computer.
audio.removeAsk: Remove “{name}” from the video? The file stays in the media library.
audio.missing: This file is gone from the media library. Remove it from the project.

roleHint.voice: Only one voice-over per video. Other sounds can get quieter while it speaks.
roleHint.sfx: A sound at the chosen moment.

audio.duckHint: This sound gets quieter while the voice-over speaks.
audio.duckNeedsVoice: Works when one of the sounds is a voice-over.
audio.previewHint: The player above plays only the sound of the video. Added sound is heard in the preview on the “Save” tab.

export.previewHint: A quick small video to check how it all looks and sounds. It is not added to the media library.
export.title: Save the video
export.hint: The result is saved as a new file in the media library. The original video stays as it is.
export.parts: Cut into {n} file | Cut into {n} files
export.partsHint: You marked split places on the timeline. Each part becomes a separate file.
export.done: The video is saved to the media library
export.cancelAsk: Stop? What is done so far will be lost.

warnings.image_skipped: Some pictures were left out: their files are missing or are not pictures.
warnings.too_many_overlays: Too many pictures over the cut pieces, some were left out. Use fewer pictures or fewer cuts.

model.label: Speech model
model.help: Which model makes subtitles by default. “Accurate” makes fewer mistakes, “Fast” works faster and takes less disk space.

language.label: Language of speech
language.help: Which language to expect by default. “Find automatically” lets the model decide.

speedTurbo.label: Speed of the accurate model
speedTurbo.help: Seconds of work per minute of video. Used for the time estimate until the app has measured a few runs on this computer.

speedSmall.label: Speed of the fast model
speedSmall.help: Seconds of work per minute of video. Used for the time estimate until the app has measured a few runs on this computer.

errors.clip_not_video: This file is not a video. The editor opens only videos.
errors.clip_file_missing: The video file is gone from the media library.
errors.clip_no_brand: This project has no brand kit.
errors.clip_empty: Nothing is left: the whole video is cut out.
errors.clip_too_many_pieces: Too many pieces: at most {max} in one video. Bring back some cut parts.
errors.clip_no_duration: Could not find out how long the video is. The file may be damaged.
errors.clip_stt_model: This speech model is not known.
errors.stt_bad_request: The speech service did not understand the request. Details are in the log.
errors.stt_not_found: The speech service could not find the video file.
errors.stt_model_not_found: The speech model was not found. Download it again.
errors.stt_busy: Speech recognition is busy with another video. Try again when it finishes.
errors.stt_no_audio: There is no sound in this video.
errors.stt_download_failed: Could not download the speech model. Check the internet and try again.
errors.stt_transcribe_failed: Could not recognize the speech. Details are in the log.
errors.stt_internal_error: The speech service failed. Details are in the log.
errors.stt_failed: Speech recognition failed. Details are in the log.
